title: Backend core: database, todo routes and the server
summary: Build the server side that stores and serves todos. It uses the users and todos tables from server/schema.sql (Level 2). The auth middleware arrives in Level 4, so for now read the user id from a placeholder you replace later.

files_to_write.purpose: Open one SQLite connection to the file named in DATABASE_FILE (default todos.db), create the tables from schema.sql, and export the connection.
An Express router for /api/todos: list, search by title, create, update the done flag, and delete, always scoped to the current user.
Create the Express app, parse JSON bodies, add GET /api/health, mount the todo router at /api/todos and export the app.
Load .env, start the app on PORT (default 4000) and log the address.

inputs: POST /api/todos with a JSON body { title }
outputs: Todo routes answer JSON arrays or objects; POST answers 201 with the new id; DELETE answers 204
Rows in the todos table belong to the user who created them

acceptance_checks.how_to_verify: Start the server and open http://localhost:4000/api/health.

acceptance_checks.description: Every query that uses outside input passes it as a parameter, never by building the SQL string.
acceptance_checks.how_to_verify: Read each db.prepare call: values must go through placeholders.

acceptance_checks.description: A user can only list, change or delete their own todos.
acceptance_checks.how_to_verify: Check that every todo query filters by the current user's id.
